question: Should ClawHub supersede the prior fixed MIT-0 policy and support declared standard MIT licenses for skills whose root package or license metadata says MIT?
rationale: The patch is technically focused, but it changes the legal/product contract for published skills and conflicts with prior maintainer direction; automation cannot choose that policy.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0 policy
options.body: Close or supersede this PR and resolve the linked issue through documentation, publisher consent, or package remediation unless maintainers intentionally reverse the existing policy.

options.title: Approve narrowed MIT support
options.body: Continue with this PR after fixing the stale test and consent copy, adding upgrade/backfill proof, providing real behavior evidence, and clearing CI.

options.title: Pause for legal review
options.body: Leave this PR and the linked issue open until maintainers decide obligations for already-published packages that declare MIT upstream.

recommendation.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0 policy
recommendation.body: Close or supersede this PR and resolve the linked issue through documentation, publisher consent, or package remediation unless maintainers intentionally reverse the existing policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest prior product-direction signal for fixed MIT-0 licensing and authored the focused enforcement commit.
